task.claim:
For each of the 18 curves of research/endosweep_dk_exact_20261016/dk_exact.json
(x962/prime239v2, nums/ed-255-mers, nums/w-255-mers, nums/numsp256d1,
other/BADA55-R-256, other/MDC201601, other/ssc-288, arkworks/ed_on_bw6_761,
nums/ed-383-mers, nums/ed-384-mont, nums/w-384-mont, bn/bn510,
nums/w-511-mers, gost/id-tc26-gost-3410-2012-512-paramSetC, nums/w-512-mont,
other/ssc-512, bls/BLS12-638, arkworks/bw6_767), with p, t, h, n, D_K, f,
s and the factorisation as recorded there:
  p + 1 - t = h*n;
  t^2 - 4p = D_K * f^2;
  4p - t^2 = prod p_i^e_i (the factorisation certificate);
  the odd-exponent p_i multiply to s, and D_K = -s or -4*s as
    nist.exact_discriminant computes it; D_K is a discriminant;
  min_nonscalar_degree(D_K) is the recorded value, 2^L <= |D_K| < 2^(L+1)
    and min_nonscalar_degree(D_K) >= 2^(L-2);
  and, if the listed factors above 10^8 are prime, D_K is a fundamental
    discriminant.
Moreover D_K = -3 on bn/bn510, bls/BLS12-638 and arkworks/bw6_767, and on
the other 15 curves |D_K| >= 2^235 and min_nonscalar_degree(D_K) >= 2^233.
